gizmo.title: Ndepụta nlele nwere ntụpọ
gizmo.description: Ndepụta igbe nlele. Ndị na-agụ akwụkwọ na-akara ihe, a na-echetakwa ọganihu ha na ngwaọrụ nke ha.

configure.title: Aha
configure.description: Aha ndepụta ahụ. A na-agụpụta ya dịka akara aha otu igbe nlele ahụ.

configure.title: Ihe
configure.description: Ihe ọ bụla bụ igbe nlele. Ndị na-agụ akwụkwọ enweghị ike ịgbanwe ihe akaralarị ma ọ bụ ndị agbanyụrụ.

configure.title: Nwere nọmba
configure.description: Gosi ndepụta nwere nọmba kama nke nwere ntụpọ.

configure.title: Ọnọdụ
configure.description: Na-agbanwe agba ka o kwekọọ na stop-note.

developer.title: Id nchekwa
developer.description: Id pụrụ iche e ji echeta ọganihu onye na-agụ akwụkwọ na ngwaọrụ ya. Emepụtara ya na-akpaghị aka; gbanwee ya naanị iji kekọrịta ọganihu n'etiti ndepụta ma ọ bụ ịmalite ọhụrụ.
